title: Cabinet Approves ₹10,000 Crore One-Time ATF Price Stabilisation Corpus for Airlines
summary: Buffers Scheduled Indian Airlines against 2.5x surge in Aviation Turbine Fuel prices.

blocks.content: Buffers Scheduled Indian Airlines against 2.5x surge in Aviation Turbine Fuel prices.

items: Budgetary Support: Disbursed as interest-free advances to Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) for up to 36 months.
Volatility Context: ATF prices surged from ₹60.50/L in March 2026 to ₹142/L in May 2026 due to West Asia crisis.
Cost Impact: ATF accounts for 40% to 60% of airline operating expenses.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Union Civil Aviation Minister: Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu | MoPNG Minister: Hardeep Singh Puri.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ATF cost share in airline operations (40% to 60%) vs support corpus (₹10,000 crore).
